Fins At Sharky's.modificationNotice: Resized, cropped for display and converted to WebP.
Fins At Sharky's.verification: File is titled "Sharky's Pier" and shows the pier building on the Venice Fishing Pier; the guide's own pick text says Fins is "the upscale sister to casual Sharky's next door, on the Venice Fishing Pier," so this photo shows the exact pier complex housing both restaurants, not Fins' own separate signage.
